name: suppression-dormancy
description: With the unused code of an unexported declaration set to allow, a record that matches a finding the setting withholds is dormant: neither in effect nor stale. A record for an unused parameter on a function whose parameter is read matches no finding and is stale, although its function falls with a component the setting withholds, because dormancy is read from the findings a record matches and never from the component of its symbol.
